statements: The nested conditions in transition in src/tickets.mjs are hard to change. Replace them with a table exported as transitions from src/flow.mjs, keyed by status then action, so that a new action is one entry.
Then add the action reopen: a closed ticket becomes open again, by anyone who may close it, and its assignee is cleared. It emits ticket.reopened.
Every other answer, error and event stays exactly as it is today.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Turn the ticket workflow into a transition table and add reopen, as the numbered statements describe. Nothing else may change. Follow the conventions already in the code.
